laws.rule: All family law matters are based on local religious laws. This includes child custody and divorce decisions. If you're involved in custody or other family disputes, speak to a lawyer before you leave Australia. Ask for advice on how religious law may affect your family circumstances. Lebanon has not signed the Hague Convention on the Civil Aspects of International Child Abduction. There are significant limits on our ability to assist in returning a child to Australia if they have been abducted by a parent. We can't intervene in local legal matters, including custody disputes. culture-and-protocol.dress_and_conduct: Do not take photographs in Hizballah areas (southern Beirut suburbs, the Beqaa Valley, the south) or of military sites; photograph only at tourist sites. Flying drones without permission is illegal. Dress codes are more relaxed than elsewhere in the region, but dress modestly at religious sites and take care during Ramadan. Even small amounts of drugs can bring prison.

visa-preparation.entry_summary: Smartraveller advises Do not travel. Australians can get a tourist visa on arrival: Lebanese General Security lists Australia for a free one-month visa, extendable to 3 months. Evidence of travel to Israel leads to refusal of entry.
visa-preparation.fastest_entry: Free one-month tourist visa at the point of entry.
visa-preparation.before_departure: Check that nothing shows travel to Israel, carry identity documents (names are checked against a border alert database), and give General Security your address in Lebanon.

steps.step: Get the free one-month tourist visa on arrival; extensions up to 3 months are possible.
Tell General Security your current address in Lebanon.
Remove anything that shows travel to Israel (stamps, border stamps from Israel crossings, tickets, tags, SIM cards): it leads to refusal, deportation or arrest.
Carry supporting identity documents: names are checked against a 'stop order' database on arrival and departure.

documents: Passport with no evidence of travel to Israel
